author: 1v1Me_
body:
Dear Staff,

I have gotten permission from a staff member on my appeal more formally because my last appeal was very sloppy and not written well. If you have read my appeal from the last time you basically know my story. If you were a 13 year old kid and you could get a mine craft account for cheap and not have to pay $25 for one. I seriously didn't know what EULA was until a week ago. Im sorry for getting the account but it is not my fault that he got banned and since he has used this account so it has his ip address. I was talking to an avicus member about it and he said I should get him to say that I bought the account before he got banned or something like that. I would do that but he kind of hates me, lol. I don't know why but in 6th grade and 7th grade we were best friends. Then when we were put in different classes we never talk and we lost friendship. 


Thank You for reading and can you please tell me what I should do

Sincerely 
1v1Me
